text:
alex: quick shift-swap — leaving notes for the evening shift. what i did: scaled kvproxy pool in eu-west1 after regen latency spike (~80ms -> 300ms p95), triggered warmstart on 3 nodes, rolled a small config tweak to embed-ingest to reduce parallelism. saw a couple of 504s during the spike but they cleared after scale.

alex: current incidents: 1) regen-eu-west1 latency spike — mitigated (scaled pool + warmstart). 2) embed-ingest retry storm on staging caused test failure in pipeline-qa (isolated to staging, not prod).

alex: mitigations in place: increased kvcache replicas from 4->6 (autoscaler sticky), applied a conservative max-parallelism of 8 to ingest workers, added a short TTL for prefix cache to avoid over-evictions. watching for 30m.

alex: blockers/asks: need approval for PR #5821 (reduce ingest parallelism) and #5824 (autoscaler backoff tweak). also, the autoscaler healthcheck still flakes occasionally — see logs below.

alex: logs snippet:
```
kvproxy WARN evicting keyset=0 size=1.2GB
ingest ERROR retry-loop exceeded backoff (400s) -> temporarily throttled
```

maria: taking the shift, thx for the handoff @alex. i'll keep monitoring eu-west1 and will escalate if p95 > 200ms after 10m. i'll merge #5821 if CI green and coordinate with infra for #5824 approval tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

maria: quick q — is the runbook link for regen spike under /runbooks/regen-euw or the new incident repo? can you paste it here?

alex: runbook is in git: https://git.redwood.internal/runbooks/regen-eu-west — short checklist is at top. key commands if you need to force warmstart:
```
kubectl -n inference exec deploy/kvproxy -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sS localhost:8080/admin/warmstart"
kubectl scale --replicas=6 deploy/kvproxy -n inference
```

deploy-bot: deploy finished: embed-ingest v2026.03.17-7c9a (success) — rolled at 1715012000.

sanjay: FYI saw a flaky unit in pipeline-qa referencing mocking of S3; opened ticket #914. not urgent for prod but might block #5821 CI.

maria: noted @sanjay, i'll re-run the CI once the mock patch lands. adding action items: (1) merge #5821 if CI passes, (2) ping infra for autoscaler review on #5824, (3) monitor regen p95 and post update in 30m. tagging oncall-alerts if it regresses.

maria: leaving one pager in the thread for whoever follows: status=stable, mitigations applied, followups=open[#5824,#914], next-check=1715014700. good handoff, alex — enjoy the rest of your day! :coffee!
